 ) rn
 FROM trial_frontier t
 JOIN v w ON w.aid=t.wid
 JOIN trial_members m ON m.wid=t.wid AND m.sy=t.sy AND m.ey=t.ey
 JOIN p e ON e.sid=m.sid AND e.yr BETWEEN t.sy AND t.ey AND e.qtr=w.qtr AND e.aid<>t.wid
 JOIN changing c ON c.wid=t.wid
)

ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY d.act,d.s,d.e
          ORDER BY CAST(p.oxygen AS REAL),p.dt,
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.tm,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,p.tm,p.site,p.act
        ) rn
 FROM d JOIN p
  ON CAST(p.yr AS INTEGER) BETWEEN CAST(d.s AS INTEGER) AND CAST(d.e AS INTEGER)
 AND CAST(p.qtr AS INTEGER)=CAST(d.qtr AS INTEGER)
 AND instr(';'||d.cohort||';',';'||p.site||';')>0
 AND p.act<>d.act
)

   CASE WHEN a."ActivityStartTime/Time"='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,a."ActivityStartTime/Time",c.site,c.aid) rn
 FROM cand cc JOIN changed ch ON ch.aid=cc.aid JOIN front f ON f.sc=cc.aid
 JOIN members m ON m.sc=f.sc AND m.sy=f.sy AND m.ey=f.ey
 JOIN comp c ON c.site=m.site AND CAST(substr(c.dt,1,4) AS INT) BETWEEN f.sy AND f.ey
   AND CAST((CAST(substr(c.dt,6,2) AS INT)-1)/3 AS INT)+1=cc.qtr AND c.aid<>cc.aid
 JOIN act a
